answerable.q: How many days a week are people in the office?
answerable.answer: People are in the office three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday).

answerable.q: How much annual leave do I get?
answerable.answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave.

answerable.q: Is there a learning budget, and how big is it?
answerable.answer: Yes, there is a learning budget of INR 40,000 per person per year.

answerable.q: How long is the technical interview?
How many steps are there in the hiring process?
answerable.answer: The hiring process consists of four steps.
Candidates who move to Pune for the role receive a one-time relocation allowance of INR 60,000 and 14 days of temporary accommodation.

answerable.q: What does the health insurance cover?
answerable.answer: The group health insurance covers the employee, a spouse or partner, and up to two children, with a coverage limit of INR 500,000 per family.

answerable.q: How long is the probation period?
answerable.answer: New employees have a probation period of 3 months.

answerable.q: When will I hear back after my final interview?
answerable.answer: We aim to give you a decision within 5 working days of your final interview.
The head office is in Pune, India.

answerable.q: Can I get adjustments for the interview if I need them?
answerable.answer: Yes, you can request interview adjustments such as extra time, a different format, or an accessible venue by informing the recruiter, and it will not affect how your application is judged.

answerable.q: Will you tell me the salary range?
answerable.answer: Salary ranges are not published in the job posting; the recruiter will share the range with you during the first call.

answerable.q: Which skills are required for this role?
answerable.answer: The role requires at least 2 years of professional backend experience, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
AWS experience is not required; it is listed as a nice‑to‑have skill.
